# LaunchLoom progress update - 2026-11-12

## 2026-11-12T15:40Z Client copy replacement targets

- Client feedback that quotes the primary button label returned `manual`: `business.primaryCta`, `business.tagline`, and `business.offer` were never replacement targets, even though they render as copy.
- They are now targets alongside the existing copy, service, process, FAQ, and differentiator fields. The single-match rule is unchanged, so a phrase that appears in several rendered fields still fails closed.
- Validation: `tests/client-feedback-ops.test.ts` 10/10, including a new unique-fragment case and an ambiguity case.

## 2026-11-12T16:05Z Client revision branch alias

- The client revision applied its copy change and deployed successfully at a deployment hash URL, but the branch alias stayed 404 and the workflow failed before sending the developer preview.
- `SAFE_REQUEST` truncated a UUID to 24 characters, which left a trailing hyphen. A Cloudflare Pages branch alias is a DNS label, so `review-client-revision-2428ef16-47a7-4fea-8fe4-.project.pages.dev` can never resolve.
- The token now strips leading and trailing hyphens after truncation and rejects any remaining non-DNS character. Regression test added.

## 2026-11-12T17:00Z Three delivery blockers: claims, contrast, reuse

Real preview runs on intakes 83, 146 and 278 exposed three distinct blockers. Two are fixed and shipped; the third is partially done.

### 1. Invented business claims (fixed, `77094444`)

Intake 83 failed with `Generated copy includes unsupported business claims`. Two separate bugs produced that one message.

- False positive: the client submitted the service name "24/7 Rapid Emergency AC Repair & Diagnostics" verbatim, but the availability rule only consulted `availability`, `responseTime` and `hours`. Every faithful FAQ question about that service was rejected as an invented promise. The rule now credits the always-on, same-day and emergency facts a client establishes through a submitted service name.
- Genuine fabrication: the intake supplies no credentials or warranty, and the model invented "licensed and insured" plus a lifetime warranty in `differentiators`. The copy prompt now forbids added credentials, guarantees and availability, and requires an empty array when the brief supplies no differentiators.
- Verified matrix: client says 24/7 and copy says 24/7 passes; client says 24/7 and copy invents same-day is blocked; client says nothing and copy says 24/7 is blocked; client hours 24/7 with copy 24/7 passes. 144 tests across the claim and site-config suites, `npm run check` 0 errors and 0 warnings over 545 files.

### 2. Pack contact-link contrast (fixed, `94b59997`)

Runs 146 and 278 failed rendered verification with white text on `#f5f4f0` at 1.1:1 and invisible focus rings.

- Regression, not a design choice: commit `26bc4705` widened a correct `.xp-guide__contact` rule to `[class*="__contact"] a`, forcing `--on-brand-surface` white onto every pack's contact band. The guide pack genuinely sits on the brand surface; the service, ledger and results packs sit on light paper and already had readable ink, navy and signal link colours.
- Scoped the brand-surface pairing back to the guide pack and gave each other pack its own link colour plus a matching focus ring. Swapped the FAQ disclosure marker from the `--brand` fill colour to the text-safe `--brand-ink` role, which was 1.6:1 against the 3:1 non-text minimum.
- 64 tests pass on merged main across the claim, contact-contrast, colour-contrast and contrast-sweep suites. Deploy `43263769240` succeeded at `94b59997`.
- Not verified: the rendered acceptance gate has not been re-run against a live launch since this change, so the pixel-level result is unproven.

### 3. Reusable candidate session (incomplete)

- The reuse path hard-requires a frozen `reasoning-preflight.json`, but DeepSeek authoring never creates one and records `creativeSession: null`. It then accepted a stale October file claiming `openai/gpt-6-luna`, which contradicts the run record.
- Partial work sits on `codex/launchloom-reuse-session` at `8dd872d2`: validation now binds to the run's own recorded session, permits the no-session case with a deterministic identity check, and rejects a bundled session that contradicts the record. Workflow input plumbing and tests are outstanding. Not merged.
